dataset: KMNIST (Kuzushiji-MNIST, Japanese cursive; third source distinct from split-MNIST and CIFAR-100)
modality_note: grayscale handwriting FORMAT like MNIST but a genuinely different SOURCE (Japanese characters, different writers); a real third source, though not a different modality
question: can a bounded retrieval mechanism select previously observed information that improves the decision beyond recency, similarity, frequency, and random retrieval after charging retrieval cost
strongest_simple_control: nearest_similarity (a successful nearest-neighbour lookup is NOT automatically a novel memory mechanism; R1 must beat it)
construct_validity_gate: reuse the calibrated Phase 4B battery (positive admitted, null pruned, oracle-free invalid); prove oracle retrieval headroom + residual beyond nearest-similarity
only_positive_licenses_cluster: only canary_positive licenses the full R1+P1R factorial Cluster B; a valid R1 null triggers a bounded third-source P1R replication and terminates the cluster path
claim_ceiling: controlled real-data retrieval canary; positive licenses only the bounded Cluster B factorial, not activation
